motion.name: book-opening
motion.value: 8900ms motion; hinge 0-2200ms; ink 1800-4200ms; first-visit reading hold; color 4500-6200ms; zoom 6500-8900ms
motion.purpose: Draw a recognizable ink landscape with soft tonal wash, contours and sparse hatching on physical parchment. Offer the skippable first-visit prologue before color and camera entry. Reduced motion bypasses camera movement and typewriting, retaining readable pages.

motion.name: book-effects
motion.purpose: Fade half-resolution GTAO (radius 0.22, thickness 0.12, blend 0.65), bloom (threshold 2.8, strength 0.12, radius 0.25), film grading and vignette to zero; render the final original frame directly.

motion.name: book-handoff
motion.purpose: Keep the final book view until the intro draws; Westwood and AkulaFlow continue on the same original landscape.

motion.name: book-options
motion.purpose: Pause the adventure before capturing its frame; reveal controls on the left page and a recognizable 320x136 location-and-character illustration without the HUD on the right. Restore the complete frame during return; resume game clocks only after the handoff.

motion.name: book-rendering
motion.value: up to 30fps settled; full refresh during transitions
motion.purpose: Keep ambient lighting dim and animate the visible candle and its warm light together, with a subtle emerald light at the cursor. Suspend rendering and transition clocks while hidden; reduced motion uses a static candle and bypasses book transitions.

motion.name: book-controls
motion.purpose: Give parchment controls restrained feedback with a 2px hover label shift and 1px pressed movement. Disable decorative transitions under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Open the closed book. Start Journey inside the book uses a bold parchment menu choice.

components.name: Options action
components.description: Controls on the left parchment page of fullscreen Options, opened from the original HUD button while the game is paused.

components.name: Book settings
components.description: Main menu and gameplay Options share scrollable parchment pages. Language and speed fields align in two columns; help, history and credits remain inside the book.
components.css: .ds-panel{padding:24px;background:#d1b885;color:#38200d;font:16px/1.4 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}.ds-panel h2{font:small-caps 25px/1.16 Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 16px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid #70492370;padding-bottom:10px}.ds-panel p{margin:0}

components.name: Book dropdown
components.description: Static visual sample of BookSelect.vue. The real component provides a parchment listbox with selected gem, keyboard navigation, Escape dismissal and upward opening when needed.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:4px;color:#38200d;font:13px/1.3 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}.ds-field button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;color:inherit;background:#e5ce9c25;border:1px solid #79502d80;border-radius:2px;font:16px/1.4 Georgia,serif;cursor:inherit}.ds-field button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #81511d;outline-offset:-3px}

narrative.overview: Old leather, wood, aged gold and emerald fittings make the browser feel part of Kyrandia. A Blender-modeled book carries the cleaned original cover composition embossed into leather, retaining only The Legend of Kyrandia title. Menu controls read as ink on its pages. The original 320 × 200 game fills the stage once the camera enters the book, with no external masthead, toolbar or footer.
keyCharacteristics: Original cover composition and pixel game scenes, with a physical Blender-modeled book as the entrance.
User-preferred coarse horizontal walnut boards with knots and scars, rich oxblood leather, worn gilding and brass patina.
Dim surroundings, warm candlelight, a subtle emerald cursor glow and dark ink on aged parchment.
Camera motion links the game to its book; a restrained living candle gives the visible table atmosphere.
rules: Use the original HUD Options button to pause the game and pull its captured frame back into a fullscreen book spread. Put controls on the left page and the recognizable current location and characters without the HUD on the right. Inventory remains in the original game HUD; keep credits inside Settings.

At Kallak, pull back into the same book for Start Journey, Load game, Settings and How to play. Use aligned custom parchment dropdowns for English/Russian and walking speed, with keyboard navigation and reduced-motion support.

Translate implemented dialogue, UI, items and location names at presentation time through src/i18n.ts and src/locales/ru-game.json, preserving original engine strings. Persist the selected language locally; initially follow the browser language. Use the bundled Cyrillic font and readable serif text.

Offer the authored four-page prehistory on the first visit and through The story so far in Settings. It is a spoiler-light retelling, not a recovered original script. Read src/components/prologue.ts and the original manual, official hint book and Malcolm's Revenge sources linked in DESIGN.md.

Offer three named local manual save slots with location, date and thumbnail; preserve the complete world state and settings. Continue journey selects the latest valid save. Confirm replacement and report damaged/full/blocked storage without silently erasing data.
Show the transparent AkulaFlow intro mark over the original Kyrandia landscape used by Westwood, preserving the existing reveal and fade.

Use extractor/materials/cover-illustration.png, an ImageGen edit of the supplied original cover composition that removes retail logos, rating and edition labels except The Legend of Kyrandia title. Do not claim exact source pixels are retained. Export its leather relief via extractor/model_storybook.py to public/assets/interface/storybook.glb.gz; retain the editable .blend in ignored .reference/.

Use extractor/materials/aged-walnut.webp, restored from the generated desk.webp in d675c1e, on one solid tabletop: its board seams are already in the image. Embed the texture in the GLB without a duplicate runtime download.
Fill the viewport with the table; place the candle behind the book on the right, outside the hinge arc. Keep the spine fixed to the back board below the page surface.

Draw assets/intro/logo_bg.png into lit parchment with a soft tonal wash, restrained contours, sparse hatching and a small gold trace before washing in color; do not begin with a grayscale photo on a floating plane. Use the same readable treatment for captured scenes.
Preserve the original pointer over the HUD Options hit area and its shared touch handlers. Book controls inherit the magical cursor; avoid a sudden system-hand cursor when crossing buttons.
Keep the original landscape's exact pixel colors at handoff by fading scene effects out before the final frame. FantasyBook.vue, storybookInk.ts and bookTransition.ts are the implemented sources.
Measure the complete production build and packed book model separately after changes; neither has a fixed size promise.
dos: Do keep the game view unobscured outside explicitly opened dialogs and the next action visible.
Do keep controls and credits inside the game presentation.
Do preserve the original cursor, pixel density and scene framing.
Do check the book, menu, help and settings at desktop and narrow mobile sizes.
Do retain reduced-motion and WebGL-fallback paths.
Do preserve the supplied original cover composition while removing its retail labels except the title, and keep the original landscape through the book-to-intro handoff.
Do check English and Russian wrapping, custom dropdown keyboard behavior and recognizable illustrations without the HUD.
Do draw the illustration into the physical parchment and remove scene effects before the final original game frame.
Do keep props outside the cover's hinge arc.
donts: Don't replace generated material art with generic gradients or decorative cards.
Don't render the candle while hidden or under reduced motion, advance game clocks behind Options, or replace the captured scene with a generic book illustration.
Don't add oversized downloads or ornamental controls without a functional reason.
